purpose: Calibration dataset for the Information Gain Gate. The gate answers 'does this knowledge surface independently add distinct governed knowledge or a distinct reference task worth preserving and retrieving?' — never 'did we rewrite the prose enough?'.
rules: No arbitrary numeric similarity threshold is defined or ratified. IG decisions are semantic and multi-signal.
Textual similarity is ONE diagnostic signal among many, never a standalone blocker and never an optimization target.
Thresholds/weights are ratified only after labelled-pair calibration (DECISION_LOG). None is introduced here.
Pairs seeded here are REAL, derived from the Reference Production 01 (MoS2) exercise.

pair_record_schema.endpoints_rule: Each pair has TWO endpoints. An endpoint is either a route (route_a / route_b = a routes.json route_id) OR a governed object (object_a / object_b = a governed object ref such as a knowledge_object_id, optionally suffixed '#<module>'). Every pair MUST supply endpoint A (route_a or object_a) and endpoint B (route_b or object_b).
pair_record_schema.signals_note: signals is an object keyed by the signal names above; values are qualitative (e.g. disjoint/low/partial/high). textual_similarity carries 'diagnostic_only' and never decides the label.
pair_record_schema.numeric_scoring_rule: No numeric similarity cutoff or signal weighting field is permitted; IG decisions are semantic.

pairs.label: valid_domain_specific_reference
pairs.rationale: The scientific KO (formula/structure/lattice; sources PubChem/NIST/COD/RSC; concept-level claims) and the German lexical surface (Spektrum dictionary-entry observation; lexeme LEX-DE-MOS2-001; terminology claim CLM-TERM-MOS2-DE-001) share NO governed evidence, claims, or sources and serve different reference tasks. Deleting one loses governed knowledge the other does not hold.

pairs.rationale: The legacy 14K route /molybdenum-disulfide/ targets the SAME scientific-reference task but holds no governed knowledge. Because the tasks coincide, a NEW independent URL alongside it is not warranted (near_duplicate surface): the KO's value is realized by governing that topic, not by minting a second URL. Note: this pair does NOT authorize retiring/migrating the legacy route (out of scope); it is a comparison candidate only.
